initial.name: lvpaopao
initial.description: Read Lvpaopao rankings, search titles and inspect actual catalogs in a qualified local WeChat runtime. rankings returns current board labels, source positions and identities; page with the same boardType, count and returned coldStartTime. download_series accepts a title (asks for selection when ambiguous) or selected source IDs, persists each actual episode and resumes the same task. Only account-playable episodes are downloaded; no purchases, ads or unlocks. series_status reads local task progress by source IDs without a native connection. Completion requires every catalog episode and verified local files. Unknown outcomes require original-key download_status, never a fresh acquisition key. Open/reopen Lvpaopao when status reports waiting-target. Results do not grant reuse rights.

boardType.description: rankings: board type from returned boards; defaults to the app reputation board (6).

coldStartTime.description: rankings: reuse the returned timestamp with the same board and count for subsequent pages.

query.description: search/download_series: title. download_series selects only one exact match; otherwise use returned candidates.

srcAppId.description: Source AppID returned by search; required with dramaId except title lookup.

dramaId.description: Source drama ID, kept as a string. series_status uses this identity to read saved progress.

count.description: episodes/rankings: bounded page width, at most 20. Keep the same width when paging a ranking.

episodeNo.description: download_episode/download_status: actual episode number from the catalog.

idempotencyKey.description: download_episode/download_status: original durable 64-character lowercase hex key; reuse it for all retries and reconciliation.

outputDir.description: Downloads/series_status: defaults to downloads/lvpaopao in this Session workspace. Relative paths stay inside it; external paths require full file access. Reuse the same destination when resuming.
